properties.name: A1788/26 / TTZP
properties.originalText:
A DEBRIS RESPONSE AREA, HAS BEEN DEFINED WITHIN THE PIARCO FIR
DUE TO THE LAUNCH OF THE 'SPACE X STARSHIP FLIGHT 15' ROCKET. 
ALL NORTHBOUND TRAFFIC OPERATING WITHIN THE CONTINENTAL AIRSPACE ARE
ADVISED TO ROUTE USABO OR WEST DCT PERGA DCT 1400N06230W FPL, OR VIA
USABO OR WEST DCT BGI FPL TO TRAVERSE THE AFFECTED AREA. ALL
SOUTHBOUND TRAFFIC ARE TO UTILIZE THE RECIPROCAL ROUTES.
IN THE EVENT OF A MALFUNCTION OF THE VEHICLE, THE DEFINED AREA MAY
BECOME AFFECTED BY FALLING DEBRIS. 
IF ATC IS INFORMED OF A MALFUNCTION, ACTION WILL BE TAKEN TO ADVISE
FLIGHT CREW OF AIRCRAFT OPERATING WITHIN THE DEFINED AREA OR ENROUTE
TO THE AREA OF POSSIBLE DEBRIS. FLIGHT CREWS CAN THEN EXPECT HOLDING
OR REROUTINGS TO AVOID THE AFFECTED AREA UNTIL IT IS CONFIRMED THAT
THE AREA IS CLEAR OF
ALL FALLING DEBRIS.
AIRCRAFT ON THE GROUND AT AIRPORTS WITHIN THE PIARCO FIR TERMINAL
CONTROL AREAS WISHING TO DEPART AND HAVE FILED TO OPERATE THROUGH
THE DEFINED AREA CAN EITHER HOLD ON THE GROUND OR EXPECT REROUTINGS
TO AVOID THE AREA. 
ALL OPERATORS ARE ADVISED TO CONSIDER THE ABOVE IN THEIR FLIGHT
PLANNING.
PRIMARY LAUNCH DATE: 261113
BACK-UP DATES: 261114 261115 261116 261117 261118 261119
